content.short: Outlier Ventures copy is a leading Web3 accelerator with a portfolio of 250+ projects.
content.description: Outlier is a leading Web3 accelerator with a portfolio of more than 250 projects spanning Defi, AI & New Data Economy, Blockchain Infrastructure, and Open MetaVerse initiatives. It connects founders with a broad network of mentors, partners, and more than 500 investors, including Animoca, Draper, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera, Decasonic, Hashed, and Synergis Capital. This ecosystem supports early-stage ventures as they scale across multiple chains and Web3 domains.
